title: Rich statistical analysis beyond the minimum
evidence: src/store.rs:450 competition_statistics computes goals/match + home/away win rates; src/store.rs:487 biggest_wins ranks by margin
suggestion: None — exceeds R10's 'at least one aggregate statistic' ask

title: Cross-file fixture deduplication reconciles overlapping datasets
evidence: src/store.rs:533 build_unique_match_indices dedups on (date±1day, season, competition, normalized teams); banner reports 17516 unique matches from ~23954 raw rows; _factual.json score=1.0 (Flamengo 2019 = 28W-6D-4L, 90 pts)

title: call_tool arms use very long single-line expressions
evidence: src/mcp.rs:57-106 several match arms exceed 200 columns (e.g. line 71 team_statistics text formatting, line 83 search_players), and src/store.rs is 750 lines in one module
suggestion: Split the dense format!/tool_result lines and consider extracting query handlers; maintainability score is 0.41

title: FIFA club<->match team join relies on fuzzy name match without documented coverage
evidence: src/store.rs:739 team_overview joins players via search_players(club=team); FIFA club names (e.g. English/European club strings) may not align with Brazilian match team names, so players[] can be empty for many clubs (test at tests/behavior.rs:171 deliberately picks 'Internacional' which is represented in both)
suggestion: Document the join's expected coverage or normalize club names; not a spec violation (R8 only requires club filtering)

title: Standings correctly computed from match results, not hardcoded
evidence: src/store.rs:399 standings() aggregates points/GD from filtered matches and sorts; tests/behavior.rs:97 asserts 2019 Série A has exactly 20 clubs with Flamengo top on 90 pts
